notes: ⚠⚠ THIS FILING OPENS THE 2026 CYCLE - a deliberate FORM-CHARACTERISATION read, and the map for the sixteen further 2026 filings. WHAT THE 2026 STOCK IS. VARIANT: modern_boxAF. REVISION STRING: the footer still prints 'v. 12.23' on the cover and the Summary Page - the SAME string the 2024 filings carry - so the revision string is NOT a cycle signal here either. MASTHEAD: 'Aaron Davidson / Clerk' with the blue UTAH COUNTY CLERK / ELECTIONS DIVISION mark, unchanged from 2024. ⚠ BUT THE COVER IS A DIFFERENT PRINTING OF THAT SAME VERSION, and two changes are visible on the page: (a) THE REPORT-TYPE AND AMENDMENT CONTROLS ARE NOW SQUARE CHECKBOXES ticked with a heavy check mark, where every 2024 filing in this chunk prints ROUND RADIO CIRCLES (the 'Office Use Only' box still prints radios, so the change is confined to the filer-facing controls); (b) THE 'WHERE TO FILE' EMAIL ADDRESS CHANGED to disclosures@utahcounty.gov, where the 2024 blank says elections@utahcounty.gov - and the page's own FOOTER still prints the old elections@ address, so the blank is internally inconsistent and the change is dateable. REPORT-TYPE LIST: UNCHANGED from the 2024 characterisation in ADDENDUM M2 - five options, in the same order and the same wording, Convention and End-of-Year still absent and '30 Days after the Primary Election (If eliminated at the Primary Election)' still present. SUMMARY PAGE: LAST page (located by content), printing A / B-C / D-E / F and a close box that is UNLETTERED - identical to 2024. ⚠⚠ SCHEDULE HEADINGS - AND THE BIG ANSWER FOR THE NEXT SIXTEEN: THIS FILING USES NO COUNTY SCHEDULE FORM AT ALL. Pages 2-6 are the FILER'S OWN TYPED LEDGERS substituted for Schedules A and B (the §A2/§E5 case), so the sides are `transcribed`, NOT `no-schedule-page` - what is missing is the county's form, not the filer's entries. They are headed with the county's exact captions ('Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received', 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made') but are otherwise the filer's own: no printed grid, no rules at all (rowbands returns zero on every one of the five), no boxed rows, no per-page subtotal anywhere, and a single grand TOTAL closing each ledger. SCHEDULE A COLUMNS: Date / From / Address / Amount - FOUR columns, NO separate city-and-state column and NO IN-KIND CHECKBOX, matching §M2's 2024 finding; and the Address column already contains city and state only, the filer's own reduction, so the privacy reduction is a no-op on this filing. SCHEDULE B COLUMNS: Date / To / Description / Amount / MILES - FIVE columns, where 'Description' is a real purpose column (captured on every row) and 'Miles' is a mileage column NO COUNTY BLANK HAS; it is the filer's own, and its values are recorded in the row notes since the record shape has no field for them. USABLE ROWS PER SHEET: not fixed, because there is no grid - 41 / 16 on the Schedule A sheets and 34 / 38 / 33 on the Schedule B sheets, set by how many typed lines fit and by how many descriptions wrap to two or three lines. DO THE SCHEDULES PRINT THEIR OWN SUBTOTAL OR TOTAL? NO SUBTOTAL ON ANY SHEET - only one grand TOTAL at the end of each ledger (17,360.29 at the foot of p3 and 17,013.80 at the foot of p6). That is the §L2 trap in its purest form and it is the single most important thing to carry into the remaining 2026 filings: reconciling one sheet alone here manufactures a shortfall that does not exist, and the gate must be the multi-sheet sum against the one printed total. FOLIATION runs 1-7 in the cover's Page box and again in each ledger footer, and is complete. NO CHECKLIST DECOY is bound. Everything is BORN-DIGITAL TYPED TEXT printed and rescanned, so no figure was ever in doubt and no glyph needed settling. INTRA-DOCUMENT DATE DISCREPANCY, recorded and not adjudicated: the cover, both Schedule A sheets and the Summary carry 6/16/2026, while all THREE Schedule B sheets are footer-dated 4/16/2026 - two months earlier - even though they contain entries through 6/13/26; the filer evidently reused an earlier footer.
